Config_AutoOpen: Automatically open plugin window when Dresser/Armoire is accessed
Tutorial_Step1: This plugin helps you identify which items in your inventory are missing from your Glamour Dresser and Armoire.
Tutorial_Step2: To get started, you MUST physically open the Glamour Dresser or Armoire in the game.
Tutorial_Step3: Once opened, click the "Read Dresser/Armoire" button in the main window to scan your currently stored items.
Tutorial_Step4: You can then see which items are "New Appearances" (not stored) and which are "Duplicates" (already stored).
